spellbook.finance/limitations: Independent weighted draws do not reproduce factory collation. Original-source completeness is unknown.
Prices are nullable USD references. Simulated cards do not create physical inventory or execute purchases.

annotations.title: Open a modeled Magic booster pack

description: Open one reproducible modeled Magic booster pack from an exact parent booster box ID. Omit boxId to discover current candidates for setCode (default fdn). A chosen product returns only the sampled exact printings, modeled finish, nullable USD references, seed, retained model date, missingFields and limitations. Seed is an unsigned 32-bit integer with deterministic default 0. Reusing a seed and unchanged retained model reproduces the draw. Independent weighted draws can repeat cards; factory collation and original-source completeness are unverified. Unavailable returns a concrete reason without substituting another booster. This is read-only play, not a purchase recommendation or physical inventory opening.

boxId.description: Exact parent booster box ID returned by discovery. Omit to list booster candidates.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

seed.description: Unsigned reproducible draw seed. Defaults to 0; change it for a different modeled pack.

setCode.description: Magic set code for discovery, such as fdn for Foundations. Defaults to fdn; ignored when boxId is supplied.

name: spellbook_mtg_pack_simulator
